faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Albany?
faq.answer: Albany homeowners typically invest $4,500 to $9,500 for a full window replacement project, covering 8–12 windows in the city's characteristic bungalows and craftsman homes. Single window pricing starts around $500 installed. Homes on Albany Hill with larger windows or more complex configurations may see higher totals.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Albany?
faq.answer: Yes. Albany requires a building permit for window replacements that involve altering the rough opening size or structural framing. Like-for-like replacements of the same size may qualify for an over-the-counter permit. Our team handles the permit process on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Albany?
faq.answer: For Albany's Craftsman bungalows and 1940s–1960s homes, we most frequently install Milgard Tuscany vinyl for its clean lines and competitive pricing, Andersen 400-Series for homeowners wanting a wood interior look, and Anlin Del Mar for maximum energy performance.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Albany neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve the entire City of Albany including the Solano Avenue corridor, Albany Hill, Cerrito Vista, and all residential streets throughout the city. Albany zip code: 94706.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Albany?
faq.answer: Most Albany projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
